validity.researcher_notes: P7663 has NO gem.wiki page (wiki field empty in worklist; absent from wiki_citations.json, unlike 19 of its 20 harvested Guangxi siblings), so there is no wiki-side citation list to cross-check for this specific segment -- the ONLY support is the row's own current_ref, https://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20210326/1144324-4.shtml, used identically for Status/Fuel/PipelineType/ProposalYear. That same URL is the shared citation for at least 12 other Guangxi branch rows in this batch (P7652 Luchuan, P7654 Nanning-Fusui, P7655 Xingye, P7656 Sinopec Nanning-Zhongran Gate, P7658 Binyang, P7659 Wuzhou, P7660 Hezhou, P7661 Fangchenggang, P7662 Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu, P7664 Beihai Tieshan Port, P7665 Donggang Industrial Park, P7666 Beihai), and cross-referencing the gem.wiki citation metadata for those siblings (P4487's reference list, cite_note-:5-28) recovers the article's actual title: '附171个电源项目全名单！《广西“能源网”建设2021年工作推进方案》发布 - 北极星火力发电网' (bjx.com.cn thermal-power channel, 2021-03-26) -- i.e. 'Attached: full list of 171 POWER-SOURCE (electricity generation) projects! Guangxi "Energy Network" Construction 2021 Work-Advancement Plan released'. The headline topic is power-generation projects, not gas pipelines, so on its face the citation does not self-evidently name any gas pipeline, let alone a 'Teng County' branch -- though a provincial 'energy network' work plan could plausibly bundle a gas-pipeline annex on a later page (this URL is explicitly page 4 of a multi-page article, consistent with a trailing table of gas-network sub-projects), which is the charitable reading. I could NOT resolve which reading is correct because the page itself is unreadable: curl (plain and Googlebot UA), WebFetch, and the r.jina.ai reader proxy all return an Aliyun WAF slider-CAPTCHA challenge page instead of content (title 'Access Verification' / '百度安全验证'-class block), and archive.org has NO historical snapshot of this URL (CDX query empty) -- the one 'available' snapshot the Wayback API reported was triggered live today (timestamp 20260729) and is the same WAF challenge page, not real content. This matches url_verifier.py's own documented bot-wall false-negative pattern. The url_verifier existing_ref_checks in the worklist already show 'value not found' for Status='proposed' and ProposalYear='2021' on EVERY one of the ~13 sibling rows that cite this URL (100% failure), while Fuel/PipelineType checks all read ok only because they weren't given a value string to search for -- i.e. the failure is uniform across all rows and looks like a page-access problem, not evidence specific to Teng County being wrong. Independent corroboration attempts all failed for tooling reasons this session: WebSearch quota was exhausted (200/200) mid-task; DuckDuckGo, Baidu, and 360so.com all returned their own bot-challenge pages to a plain curl; WebFetch against Google/Bing search URLs returned no usable result snippets for '藤县 天然气管道' (Teng County natural gas pipeline) queries. Net result: I can neither confirm nor refute that a Teng County Guangxi gas branch exists -- the single citation on file is unreadable to any automated tool available this session and no second, independent source could be located. Per the standing rule that an unverifiable/GEM-only-support row is an existence flag, I am flagging it, but note this reads as a tooling/access-blocked citation rather than positive evidence of fabrication -- recommend a manual browser-based re-check of the source (or of a possible mirror/reprint of '广西“能源网”建设2021年工作推进方案' elsewhere) before deciding whether to keep, reclassify, or drop this row. No other roster entry names Teng County, so this is not a duplicate of an existing Guangxi row.
